p: unto the LORD a new song: The prophet shows that the time will come, that all nations will have opportunity to praise the Lord for the revealing of his gospel.
great: Seeing he will reveal himself to all nations contrary to their own expectation, they should all worship him contrary to their own imaginations, and only as he has appointed.
made the heavens: Then the idols or whatever did not make the heavens, are not God.
Honour and majesty are before him: God cannot be known but by his strength and glory, the signs of which appear in his sanctuary.
strength: As by experience you see that it is only due to him.
an offering: By offering up yourselves wholly to God, declare that you worship him only.
heathen that the LORD reigneth: He prophecies that the Gentiles will be partakers with the Jews of God's promise.
righteously: He will regenerate them anew with his Spirit, and restore them to the image of God.
trees of the wood rejoice: If the insensible creatures will have reason to rejoice when God appears, much more we, from whom he has taken malediction and sin.
